description: Returns live rooms and prices for one hotel and a stay window, with a booking link for each. It queries a metered rate supplier and is limited to 12 calls a minute per client, so it fits a traveler who has chosen a hotel rather than browsing several. Booking links are time-limited and expire within minutes. A link opens a checkout the traveler completes with their own details and card; this tool does not reserve, hold or confirm a room. Returns a Markdown table (room, nightly, total, refundability, link). Hotels the supplier does not carry, sold-out dates and bad dates each return a plain sentence saying which; an over-limit call says how many seconds to wait.
name: get_rates
title: Get live rates
